title: HUB for EU DEFENCE INNOVATION (HEDI): Technology watch, landscaping, foresight - Military Utility assessment - Market consultation - Defence Innovation management courses (online Information Session 27 May 2025)
description: In the context of the Hub for EU Defence Innovation, EDA intends to launch a tender to procure consultancy services in support of technology scouting, technology watch and landscaping, and military utility assessment, including market consultations, as well as defence innovation education and training. As part of the forthcoming tender, EDA is organising an information session on 27 May 2025. The services are structured in 4 LOTS: LOT 1: Technology Watch and Landscaping: Provision of a regular and structured AI supported assessment of worldwide technological developments across both defence and non-defence sectors, identifying emerging trends, weak signals, and dual-use innovations that could impact EU security and defence; LOT 2: Military Utility Assessment: Focuses on evaluating the potential military applications of emerging technologies, assessing their operational utility, and identifying pathways for adoption into defence capability development; LOT 3: Market Research and Market Consultation: Provision of expert consultancy support for conducting market research and facilitating structured market consultations to bridge gaps between innovation suppliers and defence users; LOT 4: Defence Innovation Training Courses: Development and delivery of a structured, high-quality Defence Innovation Course. The first specific contract will focus on an Intermediate Level while potential follow-up contracts will address Basic and Advanced levels. The course is aimed at fostering a harmonized understanding of defence innovation across EU Member States while equipping participants with practical skills for managing and implementing innovation projects within innovation ecosystems. LOT 1 to 3 are services within the HEDI portfolio, the so-called “Defence Frontier Insights”. The Defence Frontier Insights (DFI) service is a key component of the portfolio of activities in HEDI. By scanning and analysing advancements across both defence and non-defence industries and research organizations, DFI serves as an early identification system for technologies and their potential application which could impact the EU security and defence landscape (from both – defensive and offensive perspectives). This service not only identifies new players and technologies but also tracks weak signals that may indicate longer-term trends in the technological environment. Through DFI, HEDI aims at providing a wide spectrum actionable intelligence that informs various aspects of the innovation process: Research & Technology: By keeping a pulse on the latest research developments (i.e. weak signals analysis, patent landscaping, emerging dual-use areas, industrial and institutional reports), DFI is to provide a systemic EU (and worldwide) outlook that complements and augments efforts at the national level, ensuring that MS remain informed and up to date on potentially disruptive military technologies. Capability driven prioritization: DFI is to outline how technological innovations can potentially be transformed into actionable defence capabilities. By integrating findings from R&T and innovation pipelines, the service is to provide insights on the operational utility of new technologies, contributing through other HEDI/EDA services to a long-term capability development planning. Innovation ecosystem definition: DFI is to map out innovation ecosystems’ maturity and ability to accommodate innovation, identifying key players assessing technological readiness levels, and potential barriers to adoption, including legal consultancy, and to identify the most suitable areas for targeted support by other EDA (and wider – EU) working bodies.

title: Lieferung von 5 Stück Teleskopradlader inkl. Zubehör
description: Es sind 5 Stück Teleskopradlader zu liefern, welche verschiedenen Straßenmeistereien des Landesbetriebes Straßenwesen Brandenburg zugeteilt werden. Die Fahrzeuge sollen insbesondere für das Beladen von Streufahrzeugen und das Beschicken von Salzlöseanlagen im Winterdienst geeignet sein. Des Weiteren werden sie für Arbeiten im Straßenbetriebsdienst eingesetzt, wie zum Beispiel das Handhaben von Paletten oder das Bewegen von diversen Schüttgütern. Dabei darf das Betriebsgewicht eines Fahrzeuges 6.500 kg nicht übersteigen. Die maximale Fahrzeugbreite beträgt 2.050 mm, wobei eine Mindesthubhöhe zum Werkzeugdrehpunkt von 4.650 mm zu gewährleisten ist. Als Anbaugeräte sind zu den Fahrzeugen jeweils eine Stapeleinrichtung mit 2 Gabelzinken sowie jeweils eine Schüttgutschaufel ohne Zähne mitzuliefern. Die weiteren Parameter sind den technischen Anforderungen im Bieterangaben-Verzeichnis (BAV) zu entnehmen.

title: 5G NEW RADIO (NR) NON-TERRESTRIAL NETWORKS RELEASE 18 PROTOCOL STACK ENHANCEMENTS (ARTES 4.0 SPL 5G/6G 3F.011)
description: The objective of this activity is to develop the software protocol stack for Release 18 enhancements related to 5G New for Radio (NR) for Non-Terrestrial Networks. The software protocol stack development shall be based on a testbed considering both the User Equipment (UE) and g-NodeB (gNB) features and operational procedures.Targeted Improvements:Enable 5G NR NTN system performance simulations with the latest Release 18 modifications.Description:The 5th generation of wireless broadband networks (5G) promised a new paradigm in communications, offering higher transmission rates, more Internet of Things (IoT) and internet application connections, high reliability, very low latency, and connectivity for remote areas. The 5G New Radio (NR) adaptations for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) have been introduced for the first time in the 3GPP Release 17 specifications, to support network offloading, coverage enhancements, connectivity resilience and service continuation in remote areas. With the support of the ARTES 5G Workplan, open-source software protocol stack versions have been implemented for NTN Release 17, starting from the Open-Air Interface (OAI) and from the SRS library. Based on the current 3GPP work item description, the new Release 18 will introduce further features related to the support and the enhancements of 5G NR services in satellite networks. Among the new features, it is recalled that NTN Release 18 will supportdownlink/uplink coverage enhancement techniques, network verified UE location capabilities, NTN-TN mobility enhancements for service continuity, and the support of above 10 GHz satellite frequency bands. The proposed activity shall thus foresee the following steps: a) Review the latest 3GPP specifications for the NTN scenario (i.e., Release 17) and identify the missing models and capabilitiesof the selected library to be enhanced with features of Release 18; b) Identify key features planned for Release 19 to be added to the library; c) Software design and development of the new functions in the protocol stack of both UE and gNB to support bi-directional communication links for both GEO and NGSO satellite networks; d) Thorough laboratory validation of the new software library capabilities. This activity should target publicly available licensing model (i.e., GPL licensing).

title: Technische Gebäudemanagement (TGM) für die DLR-Standorte in Oberpfaffenhofen und Augsburg
description: Der DLR-Standort Oberpfaffenhofen zählt neben dem Standort Köln-Porz zu den größten Forschungszentren in Deutschland. Dreizehn wissenschaftliche Institute und Einrichtungen sind auf dem Areal ansässig. Derzeit beschäftigt der Standort rund 1800 Mitarbeiter. Schwerpunkte des Forschungszentrums sind unter anderem die Beteiligung an Weltraummissionen, die Klimaforschung, Forschung und Entwicklung zur Erdbeobachtung, der Ausbau von Navigationssystemen und die Weiterentwicklung der Robotertechnik. Der Standort Augsburg ist ein kleiner, sich entwickelnder Standort, an dem die Institute für Leichtbautechnik und Test + Simulation für Gasturbinen angesiedelt sind. Neben dem Bestandsgebäude wird noch ein weiters großes Institutsgebäude errichtet. Neben den bestehenden Immobilien wird der Gebäudebestand ständig erneuert und mit Umbauten an Gebäuden den jeweiligen Anforderungen angepasst. Dieses beinhaltet, dass nicht alle Gebäudeunterlagen (Anlagenlisten und Dokumentationen) von neuen Gebäuden und von Umbauten zum Vertragsanfang vorliegen. Alle diese Neuerungen werden vom Auftragnehmer implementiert, Anlagenlisten erstellt und die Dokumentation eingepflegt und gepflegt.
